artifact.name: compute_percentage_change
artifact.content:
local function round2(x: number): number
	return math.floor(x * 100 + 0.5) / 100
end

function run(input: Input, context: Context): Output
	local initial_value = input.initial_value
	local current_value = input.current_value

	if initial_value == 0 then
		return { error = "invalid_initial_value", message = "initial_value must not be zero" }
	end

	local raw_change = ((current_value - initial_value) / initial_value) * 100
	local percentage_change = round2(raw_change)
	local direction = "flat"

	if current_value > initial_value then
		direction = "up"
	elseif current_value < initial_value then
		direction = "down"
	end

	return {
		percentage_change = percentage_change,
		direction = direction,
	}
end
artifact.description: Compute rounded percentage change and direction between two numeric values.
artifact.usage_description: Use this when you need to compare an initial value and current value and return a rounded percentage change with up/down/flat direction.

artifact.name: notify_inactive_segment_customers
artifact.content:
function run(input: Input, context: Context): Output
	local listed = tools.crm.list({ segment = input.segment })
	if not listed.ok then
		return { error = listed.error, message = listed.message }
	end

	local notified: { string } = {}
	local failed: { string } = {}
	local sent = 0
	local limit = 10

	for _, customer in listed.customers do
		if customer.last_seen_days >= input.inactive_days then
			if sent >= limit then
				break
			end

			local text = "Hi " .. customer.name .. ", we miss you!"
			local result = tools.message.send({ user = customer.id, text = text })
			sent += 1
			if not result.ok then
				table.insert(failed, customer.id)
			else
				table.insert(notified, customer.id)
			end
		end
	end

	return { notified = notified, failed = failed, count = #notified }
end
artifact.description: Lists customers in a segment and messages inactive ones.
